description: Reproducible v4 RUNG_TX fund (and where applicable spend) transaction vectors. Generated by test/functional/generate_rung_tx_vectors.py — re-run to regenerate. Covers all 65 core block types across 67 vectors and the eight witness-rule families: Fixed N, Bridging, Reveal P, Triplets K, Empty, PQ-anchor, Unspendable, Accumulator, plus Compound combinations. Vectors 48-50 are boundary cases (1-of-1 multisig, point-pin amount band, CSV=0). Vectors 66-67 cover QABI_PRIME / QABI_SPEND (require build with ENABLE_QABIO=ON). Negative vectors are in rung_tx_neg_vectors.json; round-trip spend vectors are in rung_tx_spend_vectors.json — this file is positive fund-only.

vectors.name: DATA_RETURN payload + SIG vout (Unspendable witness rule)
VAULT_LOCK 2-key vault (Fixed N + 2 PUBKEYs in leaf)
PTLC point-locked HTLC (Fixed N + adaptor in leaf)
OUTPUT_CHECK (output index + value band + script hash)
ADAPTOR_SIG marker (Fixed N + adaptor in leaf)
MUSIG_THRESHOLD 3-of-5 (Triplets K + agg pubkey in leaf)
COMPARE op=gt (3 NUMERIC, Empty witness rule)
LATCH_SET state=0 (PLC + setter key in leaf)
